note: Variant of feature-edges-open-field that tests whether the word required is what makes a lead copy the log rule. The first history step adds a club config whose log key must start with log:// and exits 2 otherwise. The second adds docs/export.md, the spec for an export key that is now required in every club config, with totals --config exiting 2 when it is missing. Its one example is report://weekly, and its text never restricts the scheme. A lead that copies the log rule onto export rejects values the spec leaves open. open-scheme: with export: other://x and no --out nothing is written, so the command exits 0 and prints the totals. open-scheme-out: the spec defines the export path as what follows ://, so export: other://x with --out is not an error either. held_out.py also checks the exported files, that nothing is written without --out, the config's log behavior, that log still exits 2 for another scheme, and export-required: a config with no export key exits 2. Every other config it writes includes an export line. It runs the project's own tests against reference/strides and one mutant per edge. open-scheme rejects the export scheme while the config loads. open-scheme-out rejects it when the files are written.
